description: **`wsc audit`: a fresh claim reads as parked, and subjects are read case-sensitively**: `warscape/audit.py` (a) `parked()` ages a `progress` row by its branch head, and `wsc jobs next` claims by pushing main's sha, so on a main quiet for `max_job_hours` a job claimed a minute ago reads as parked and `idle_queue` can fire falsely: read the claim's own time, or treat a head equal to main as just claimed; (b) `subject_kind` misses `Job/j1 (#7)` and `Plan:` subjects, which read as `other`, so napoleon's job count is 69 where 70 is true. Why: W45 re-measures by id, so a false `idle_queue` becomes a proposal Raised: W44 report fix round 1; W44 review round 2 Later, 2026-11-06
title: `wsc audit`: a fresh claim reads as parked, subjects read case-sensitively
